e: This valley didn't have a telephone exchange until 1903, when the leading citizens of this town invested in a company to establish one.

s.d: Not valid; not true, correct, acceptable, or appropriate.
e: Your argument is invalid because it uses circular reasoning.
This invalid contract cannot be legally enforced.

s.d: Suffering from disability or illness.
Intended for use by an invalid.
Any person with a disability or illness.
A person who is confined to home or bed because of illness, disability or injury; one who is too sick or weak to care for themselves.
A disabled member of the armed forces; one unfit for active duty due to injury.
To exempt from (often military) duty because of injury or ill health.
e: He was invalided home after the car crash.

s.d: To make invalid or affect with disease.

tr.g: person with a handicap or disability
